Package org.example.simu.model

Class Customer

java.lang.Object
org.example.simu.model.Customer
public class Customer extends Object
Model entity representing an individual customer moving through the pizzeria simulation.

Tracks customer arrival and exit timestamps, assigns customer category types (dine-in, takeaway, online) based on configurable relative distribution weights, models ordering preferences (e.g., drink probability), and computes system-wide throughput metrics.

Version:
3.0
Author:
Illia, Niklas, Daniel, Anja

  • Constructor Details

    • Customer

      public Customer()
      Constructs a new customer instance with a randomly assigned customer type.

    • Customer

      public Customer(CustomerType type)
      Constructs a new customer instance with the specified customer type.

      Automatically assigns a sequential ID, records the current clock time as arrival time, and evaluates drink preference logic for dine-in customers.

      Parameters:
      type - The CustomerType to assign to this customer.
